title: Serialize worktree integration with a repository merge queue
body: Implement the plan in docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-17-worktree-integration-queue.md. Foreman owns a durable per-repository queue covering rebase, validation, and fast-forward; conflicts return to workers without blocking ready cards. Include cross-instance locking, restart recovery, card/CLI progress, and updated paired worker instructions. Acceptance cases and implementation sequence are in the plan.
